create_gaussian_kernel: create a Gaussian kernel numpy array given an odd kernel size and optional standard deviation
build_fclayer: build a fully connected layer with Xavier initialization and configurable nonlinear activation function
build_conv2d_untied_bias: build a Conv2d layer with per-pixel untied bias parameters instead of a single scalar bias
build_weight_norm_wrapped_layer: build a weight normalization wrapped Linear or Conv2d layer with fuse and unfuse support
build_downsample_layer: build a downsampling layer with configurable filter size, stride, and padding type for anti-aliased CNNs
